create_spiral_render_poses: create a spiral path of camera poses for 360 degree NeRF rendering
create_spherical_render_poses: create spherical camera poses at a fixed radius looking downward for rendering
center_and_correct_poses: center and correct camera poses with optional scaling and axis flipping for NeRF
interpolate_camera_poses: interpolate between camera poses using SE3 twist representation for smooth motion
compute_bounding_sphere_radius: compute the bounding sphere radius from centered camera poses for scene bounds
